residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment within India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Hospital Cash benefit has 3-day waiting period; daily compensation paid from 4th day

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent 0.5% of SI/day; ICU 1% of SI/day; medical practitioner fees 15% of SI per any-one-illness; other expenses 15% of SI per any-one-illness

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Modern Treatments (12 listed) up to 50% of SI per procedure

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs 2,500 normal / Rs 5,000 caesarean or extra-uterine
maternity_coverage.notes: 12-month waiting period; once per lifetime; covers newborn medical expenses; benefit available only to earning head or spouse

newborn_coverage.notes: New Born Baby defined as baby aged up to 90 days; medical expenses covered when linked to maternity claim

ayush_coverage.notes: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered per IRDAI standardised AYUSH Hospital definition

notable_exclusions_summary: Geographically limited to India; no fertility, dental, cosmetic, sex-change or vitamin/tonic expenses; Section II accident cover excludes self-inflicted injury and intoxication.
claim_process_summary: Online discount of 10% on premium when bought without intermediary. Premium paid annually before policy starts. Cashless via TPA in network hospitals; reimbursement otherwise. Renewable for lifetime; portability and migration permitted.
